name: Thejo Engineering Limited
summary: Thejo Engineering Limited designs, develops, manufactures, and supplies rubber and polyurethane based engineering products for bulk material handling systems, mineral processing, and corrosion protection applications in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Manufacturing Units, Service Units, and Others. The company provides conveyor care products, including belt conveyor splicing and repair solutions, pulley lagging sheets, vulcanizing equipment, and belt coiler and de coiler products, as well as school tool kits, such as hand and power tools, and personal protective equipment; and transfer point solutions comprising belt cleaners and trackers, impact cushion pads, …
